business_summary: ERTH Group Co.,Ltd. in, together with its subsidiaries, operates in residential ground compensation industry in Japan and Vietnam. The company involves in ground investigation and analysis; horizontal restoration work and ground improvement work; BPO, BIM solutions, CG solutions, domestic architectural design services, and technician training services; renewable energy infrastructure construction; and ground guarantee system. The company was formerly known as Jibannet Holdings Co., Ltd. and changed its name to ERTH Group Co.,Ltd. in October 2026. ERTH Group Co.,Ltd. in was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
